subject: Re: site transfer finished
text: Hi, just wanted to follow up after the site transfer. I know we had been worried all week that the old host would cause a mess, but everything actually finished early and the client is happy. Thanks for jumping in when you weren't even scheduled yet, and for letting my teammate shadow you on the final handoff. He keeps saying he learned more in twenty minutes than he had in the last month. I still can't believe the migration went so smoothly, especially with that plugin issue you fixed so quickly. I owe you a coffee. Seriously, thank you again. I should also thank my teammate, who stayed late and kept the client calm. It was a nice surprise to see a backup set finish without a single panic email after lunch, and I've already recommended your work to another freelancer I know.
